message: Astra: Within Ya na’s investigation, how much story time separates her opening action from “Alex” noticing her distress, and what wording supports your estimate? What remains unknown about that interval? Would further thought resolve something a drafting attempt could not, or would an attempt provide better evidence now? What uncertainty would justify waiting instead? Could you briefly state your finding and chosen next intention in English, then carry it out so we can examine something beyond the promise of revision?
